payload.name: Chopper
payload.summary: Un encuentro corto para aprender a leer un AoE circular: el error importante es recibir Parálisis.
payload.summary_es: Un encuentro corto para aprender a leer un AoE circular: el error importante es recibir Parálisis.
encounter_notes: * Charged Whisker: an AoE centred around the boss that does no damage, but inflicts Paralysis if hit.

payload.name: Captain Madison
payload.summary: El capitán aparece dos veces. La segunda pelea añade perros y una reducción de precisión al objetivo principal.
payload.summary_es: El capitán aparece dos veces. La segunda pelea añade perros y una reducción de precisión al objetivo principal.
encounter_notes: * Players will encounter Captain Madison twice.
First Encounter:
* Two adds from Captain Madison's crew will accompany him.
** Heavy Swing: additional light damage to the main target.
Second Encounter:
* Two adds from Captain Madison's crew will accompany him.
** Heavy Swing: additional light damage to the main target.
* Fast Blade: additional light damage to the main target.
* Sandslinger: inflicts the main target with a cleansable Accuracy Down.
* At 50% HP, several Scurvy Dog adds will join the fight.

payload.name: Denn the Orcatoothed
payload.summary: Mantén al grupo detrás del jefe, evita Hydroball y decide si cerrar las rejillas o matar los adds.
payload.summary_es: Mantén al grupo detrás del jefe, evita Hydroball y decide si cerrar las rejillas o matar los adds.
encounter_notes: * True Thrust: additional light damage to the main target.
* Hydroball: a conal AoE directed to the main target. Inflicts Silence if hit.
*The boss room features 4 grates with bubbling water at each corner of the room. During the boss fight, adds will spawn from the bubbling water.

** Players can interact with the grate when it is bubbling to prevent an add from spawning. To this extent, ranged DPS can position themselves to be in range to attack, while still able to quickly interact with the grates when they bubble. Should adds spawn, try to keep their numbers down to prevent the tank from being overwhelmed. If a caster is targeted by the adds, they should run to the tank so that the tank can remove hate while staying by the boss.
**In most runs, the grates and the adds they spawn are generally ignored, and all damage is focused on the boss.

payload.name: Void Soulcounter
payload.summary: Primero limpia el grupo de cultistas; después interrumpe el buff y evita el cono del Soulcounter.
payload.summary_es: Primero limpia el grupo de cultistas; después interrumpe el buff y evita el cono del Soulcounter.
encounter_notes: The dungeon's three mini-boss encounters each consist of a different initial group of enemies, followed by a Void Soulcounter:
*Group 1: Gravedigger x2, Dalamud Priest
*Group 2: Gravedigger x3, Dalamud Priest
*Group 3: Gravedigger x4, Octavel the Unforgiving
Void Soulcounter appears after the initial enemies within the arena are killed.
* Enthunder: a buff that adds additional lightning damage to auto attacks. Initial cast can be interrupted.
* Dark Orb: additional light damage on the main target.
* Comdemnation: conal AoE.

payload.name: Galvanth the Dominator
payload.summary: La regla central es sencilla: los imps enlazados vuelven invulnerable a Galvanth, así que mueren primero.
payload.summary_es: La regla central es sencilla: los imps enlazados vuelven invulnerable a Galvanth, así que mueren primero.
encounter_notes: * Mind Blast: an AoE centred around the boss that will paralyze anyone caught in it.
* Drain Touch: additional light damage to the main target, with lifesteal. Used after the first set of adds.
* Adds:
** Inconspicuous Imps will spawn and tether to the boss, making the boss invincible. Kill these enemies to make the boss vulnerable.
** Deepcroft Mitelings and Skeleton Soldiers will also be summoned.

payload.name: Angra Mainyu
payload.summary: Alterna colores en Double Vision, mira fuera durante Mortal Gaze y sal del sector seleccionado por Roulette.
payload.summary_es: Alterna colores en Double Vision, mira fuera durante Mortal Gaze y sal del sector seleccionado por Roulette.
encounter_notes: Double Vision, a floor-covering AoE that is split into red and white, which gives a stacking debuff depending on what colour you're standing on. The white AoE will give a "Sullen" debuff and the red AoE will give an "Ireful" debuff. The stacks will reset to 1 if you alternate which colour you stand on when it hits. If you get 2 stacks of the debuff you will take 2.5k damage. If you get 3 stacks you will die.

When he casts Mortal Gaze, anyone looking in his direction will receive a Doom debuff that kills you in 10 seconds. Stand on whichever one of the four circular platforms that is lit up to remove this debuff. You can also turn away from the boss when he casts the ability to completely avoid the Doom debuff.

Roulette, signified by a finger and a cone that rotates clockwise around the boss room, occurs when 4 Final Hourglasses spawn at the outer edge of the room. Kill the 4 Final Hourglass one by one. To avoid being killed, do not stand in the quarter that is lit up when the last Final Hourglass dies. As long as all four of the Hourglasses die, you will be able to run out of that section if you happen to be in it.

Level 100 Flare: Red ball spawns on a player and a red circle appears on the ground. This ability tethers several players to 1 player. You need to run out of the circle to cancel the ability. Players in the red circle will all take massive damage if the total number of players in the circle is an even number.

Level 150 Death: Purple ball spawns on a player and a purple circle appears on the ground. This ability tethers several players to 1 player. You need to run out of the circle to cancel the ability. Players in the purple circle will all die if the total number of players in the circle is a multiple of 3.
Adds should be killed or they will deal powerful raidwide damage.
===The Nape===
Enemies: Queen Scylla

Scylla will use Ancient Flare, an attack that will do raid-wide damage if not interrupted. Six Forbidden Gates will spawn, three west and three east, which will slowly begin casting Void Call. If not defeated before they finish the cast, they will turn into a Thor, which has no notable mechanics.

After defeating them, a fake Treasure Coffer will appear, which will turn into a Xande's Clone when opened, who will use Ancient Quaga, another interruptible attack. Six more Forbidden Gates will spawn, although two of them will be larger. The larger gates will turn into a Jormungand if not defeated in time, which has no notable mechanics.

payload.name: Five-headed Dragon
payload.summary: Evita hielo expansivo, controla slimes y orbes, mata las cinco cabezas durante Discordance y deja de actuar durante Heatwave.
payload.summary_es: Evita hielo expansivo, controla slimes y orbes, mata las cinco cabezas durante Discordance y deja de actuar durante Heatwave.
encounter_notes: Ice Floor's AoE expands if it hits a player. When you see a white, circular swirl on the ground, run away. Anyone who steps in these will be inflicted with Deep Freeze for several seconds and unable to move or take actions.

An orange circle AoE telegraph will leave behind a poison puddle that will spawn multiple Poison Slimes. These need to be killed to stop them from joining together and casting silence (The Last Song) on the entire raid. Killing them causes them to burst into poison resistance buffs. At least one player should stand in the puddle to prevent more slimes from spawning and turning into a Toxic Slime. This must be killed or it will explode for high damage (Fermata) and inflicting a stack of Vulnerability Up.

When the boss channels Discordance you have to kill the 5 extra heads that appear or the raid will wipe. Defeat them all with AoE attacks. The boss could use this multiple times, so stay on your toes if your DPS is slower.

The boss will occasionally mark a player with a stack marker. When this happens, a small number of players (usually 3-5) need to stack on this player to split the damage. If this does not happen, the player will receive 9999 damage.

When you see Prominence orbs appear, red circles spawn on the ground followed by red or white balls, kill the orbs ASAP before they explode (Radiance) and deal damage, inflicting stacks of Vulnerability Up.

An untargetable Dragonfire Fly will tether a player and inflicts a stacking Suppuration debuff, reducing their maximum HP and increasing damage taken. The player needs to run and touch another player to transfer the tether before the debuff kills them.
Heatwave is a raid-wide attack used when the boss' HP is low. For 5 seconds, every action you make will deal 500 damage, so players should stop moving and attacking.
===The Jaws===
Enemies: Howling Atomos (left), Moaning Atomos (center), and Roaring Atomos (right).

Each party should split off, with A going left, B middle, and C right, to isolated platforms, each containing an Atomos. The three different Atomos will periodically synchronize their HP, so they will all die together regardless of differences in DPS.

A random player will be marked with a crosshair, indicating the Atomos will use an untelegraphed conal AoE on them that will suck in anyone hit. Ideally, the marked player will jump to the ring below, and other players will avoid the marked player. Anyone sucked in will then be spit off the platform to the lower ring, granting a vulnerability down Vulnerability Down buff to the Atomos. A player on the upper platform will need to stand on the glowing white circle to activate a jump pad allowing lower players to return to the top. If all players in the entire alliance get stuck on the lower rings, the raid will wipe.

The Atomos will also use Shockwave, an untelegraphed radial knockback. Stand right under the mob when it's casting Shockwave because if you're not in that purple puddle you will get knocked off. The knockback can be prevented with Arm's Length or Surecast.
A Sacrificed Soldier add will also spawn on each platform and should be defeated. A spinning yellow disc will also move across the platform and should be avoided to prevent damage.

payload.name: Kottos
payload.summary: Lee el salto, busca el borde libre y no te quedes delante del gran cono.
payload.summary_es: Lee el salto, busca el borde libre y no te quedes delante del gran cono.
encounter_notes: *Grand Slam: Tankbuster. Tanks should use mitigation to lower the damage.
*Lumbering Leap: Kottos will jump to 3 areas, causing a massive circle AoE to appear at the location. Players should move to the small safe spot at the edge of the arena.
*Colossal Slam: A large cone AoE targeted on a random player.
*Catapult: Kottos will throw a rock at a random player, dealing moderate damage.

payload.name: Ichorous Ire
payload.summary: Muévete de los charcos personales y, al dividirse el boss, separa los pequeños slimes antes de sus explosiones.
payload.summary_es: Muévete de los charcos personales y, al dividirse el boss, separa los pequeños slimes antes de sus explosiones.
encounter_notes: *Fluid Spread: Tankbuster.
*Syrup: Circle AoEs will appear below all players, requiring them to move out of it.
*Divide: After 50% HP, Ichorous Ire will split up into many Ichorous Drips, which will each cast Burst, a circle AoE centered on the enemy.

payload.name: Gyges the Great
payload.summary: Alterna entre entrar al hitbox para el donut y buscar uno de los huecos entre círculos.
payload.summary_es: Alterna entre entrar al hitbox para el donut y buscar uno de los huecos entre círculos.
encounter_notes: *Grand Slam: Tankbuster.
*Gigantic Swing: A massive donut AoE centered on the boss. Players must move into the boss' hitbox to avoid excess damage.
*Gigantic Smash: The boss will recenter and cast a circle AoE in the center along with 5 more on the outside of the arena. Players should move into the safe spots in between the AoEs.
*Colossal Slam: A large cone AoE targeted on a random player.

payload.name: Firemane
payload.summary: El patrón clave alterna dos grupos de conos cardinales: después del primero, entra en la zona que acaba de explotar.
payload.summary_es: El patrón clave alterna dos grupos de conos cardinales: después del primero, entra en la zona que acaba de explotar.
encounter_notes: * Fire II: Circular AoE.
* Fireflow: The boss will cast two sets of 4 cones in cardinal directions. After the first set goes off, move into it to avoid the second set.
* Burning Bolt: Tankbuster.

payload.name: Thunderclap Guivre
payload.summary: Cuando toda el agua se vuelva morada, abandona la piscina y pisa una de las rampas de tierra.
payload.summary_es: Cuando toda el agua se vuelva morada, abandona la piscina y pisa una de las rampas de tierra.
encounter_notes: * Electrify: Circular AoE.
* Levinfang: Tankbuster.

* Hydroelectric Shock: The boss will start charging electricity, giving a purple glow to the entire pool of water. Retreat to the dirt slopes on the edge of the arena until the attack goes off. Ranged party members can still hit the boss while standing on the slope.

payload.name: Cerberus
payload.summary: Cuando se suelte, hazte Mini antes de entrar al charco y ser devorado; destruye las paredes del estómago y vuelve a colocar las dos cadenas.
payload.summary_es: Cuando se suelte, hazte Mini antes de entrar al charco y ser devorado; destruye las paredes del estómago y vuelve a colocar las dos cadenas.
encounter_notes: When Cerberus becomes unchained and starts Thrashing, a group of players (usually Alliance B, plus any DPS that want to) needs to execute the following in order:
Stand next to the Gastric Juice mob to get hit by File:Minimum icon1.png Mini spell and shrunk to a small size.
Stand in the purple puddle to get Devoured by the boss. (Do not stand in the puddle if you don't have the File:Minimum icon1.png Mini debuff, as Cerberus will instantly kill you.)
Once inside, kill the adds on the wall in his stomach.

When the adds are dead he will stop thrashing, and will slump to the ground in pain. Groups outside the stomach need to use the two tethers to re-chain him while he is weakened - both tethers need to be re-attached to each of the Open Fetters on his sides by interacting with them. Players who pick up the chains should not linger too long with these.

If there are fewer than 5 living players outside the belly, Cerberus will immediately eject all players inside him without collapsing. FFXIV Mythbusters | What if Cerberus Ate EVERYONE? - Caetsu Chaiji Ch.

If his belly adds are not killed or he is not re-chained, Cerberus' haste Haste and Damage Up Damage Up buffs will stack out of control and wipe the raid. There are two meta strategies for handling this mechanic:
====DPS Rush====
* All DPS should get swallowed to burn down the stomach walls as quickly as possible. One (1) healer joins them so they don't die.

DPS Rush is both faster and safer, as B alliance can be people who don't know how to get in the belly or are new. The ABC strat below is just included for reference and should only be used if most of the alliance insists on doing it.
====ABC = Adds/Belly/Chains====
* Alliance A should pull and kill the adds, Wolfsbane, which are quite dangerous if not tanked because their attack is a large cleave poison.
* Alliance B should go into Cerberus' stomach.
* Alliance C should tank Cerberus, and focus on re-chaining Cerberus whilst he is weakened.
Due to gear creep, DPS Rush is more common nowadays.
Cerberus has a Tail Swipe attack that hits players behind him in a cone.
Ululation is a roar that causes players who are not around other players to become feared for 15 seconds. Stay near your party members to avoid the fear effect.

payload.name: Cloud of Darkness
payload.summary: Corre por el borde con Feint Particle Beam, sal del centro cuando desaparezca, ocupa torres y mata nubes antes de que sean absorbidas.
payload.summary_es: Corre por el borde con Feint Particle Beam, sal del centro cuando desaparezca, ocupa torres y mata nubes antes de que sean absorbidas.
encounter_notes: Cloud of Darkness targets the tank with a powerful auto-attack that also deals damage over time, so keep your tank safe.

A random player will get targeted with red crosshairs (Feint Particle Beam). After a few seconds, blasts will start chasing after the target player at running speed damaging anyone nearby. Each blast adds a Vulnerability Up debuff and it kills you quickly if you stop moving. The player targeted should run towards the outside edge of the area, away from all other players.

Any time she moves around the ring, she fires a massive laser (Zero-form Particle Beam) through the center of the area. When she disappears, immediately move to the sides. This attack will give a Vulnerability Up debuff. This does not have a ground telegraph.

Throughout the fight, she will spawn comets on yellow circle markers (towers). At least one person should stand in each one before the comet reaches the ground or the raid suffers moderate damage (several empty comets will wipe the raid). The person in the comet area will take a small hit.

Mid-fight, the floor of the area will light up and smaller Dark Cloud and larger Dark Storm adds will start spawning. Kill them before they get close enough for the boss to eat them and gain stacks of Damage Up, or she will wipe you if she eats enough. The smaller adds will give her one stack, while the larger attacks will give three. The clouds can be affected by Heavy but not by Bind. If anyone stands between the clouds and CoD, it will add the Heavy effect to them. After the cloud phase is done she will do a raid-wide attack.

Next, she will spawn 3 Hypercharged Clouds in a triangle formation. These clouds have a box shaped outline around them and cannot be damaged outside the box after a few seconds, so move into one of the boxes and kill the clouds. A, B, and C should have their own cloud and this can be marked ahead of time with waymarks, although it is not critical to evenly split the alliances. If they are not killed before Particle Beam finishes casting, they will explode for massive damage.

If your raid DPS is very low, worm adds (Shadowlurkers) will spawn around the area before the cloud phase. Hitting them once or twice causes them to disappear. The worms add many debuffs like Morbol's Bad Breath to anyone standing too close to them. Stay away and let the ranged DPS handle. If they are left alive for too long, they will target random players with a massive AoE (Black Thunder) that deals damage and inflicts a stack of Vulnerability Up.

payload.name: Tangata
payload.summary: Rompe el escudo matando wisps antes de que alcancen al boss y ejecuta correctamente el patrón fuera-dentro.
payload.summary_es: Rompe el escudo matando wisps antes de que alcancen al boss y ejecuta correctamente el patrón fuera-dentro.
encounter_notes: * Straight Punch: Tankbuster.

* Burning Ward: At around 80% health, the boss gains a fire shield that makes it invulnerable. Two torches will light up and start spawning fire wisps, which will approach the boss, and will explode into room-wide AoEs if they reach it. Kill the wisps to disable the shield, which will give the message: . This move is repeated at about 60% HP.
* Plain Pound: Multi-stage AoE that starts as a circle, then two concentric donuts. Stand outside the initial circle, then when it goes off, move into it to avoid the donuts.
* Firewater: Circular AoE.

payload.name: Coeurl O' Nine Tails
payload.summary: Evita quedarte pegado durante Acid Mist y elimina los adds que acompañan a la segunda aparición.
payload.summary_es: Evita quedarte pegado durante Acid Mist y elimina los adds que acompañan a la segunda aparición.
encounter_notes: Coeurl O'Nine Tails are encountered twice in the instance. The second Coeurl also spawns two Warden's Whip adds.
*Acid Mist: Poisons all nearby party members.

payload.name: Graffias
payload.summary: Evita el borde pegajoso, no dejes el pod bajo el grupo y cambia a cola/adds al 50%.
payload.summary_es: Evita el borde pegajoso, no dejes el pod bajo el grupo y cambia a cola/adds al 50%.
encounter_notes: There are puddles of green goo surrounding the arena that inflict the Leaden debuff, slowing players' movement.
*Realm Shaker: An instant circle AoE around the boss that deals moderate damage.
*Silkscreen: A line AoE targeting a random player.

*Sticky Web: Graffias targets a random player, dealing minor damage and spawning an untargetable Fleshy Pod add at their position. After a few seconds, the add explodes with Pod Burst, dealing moderate damage in a circle AoE and inflicting any players hit with a Poison debuff.

At 50% HP, the boss will summon 4 Comesmite adds, and the skin on its tail will fall off as an additional target, unlocking another attack. Killing the tail will remove the attack and give the boss Vulnerability Up for 60 seconds.

*Deadly Thrust: A player will be targeted and a large green poison puddle will be placed at their position that inflicts a Pollen debuff, dealing damage over time to any players standing inside of it.

payload.name: Manor Claviger
payload.summary: El tanque la orienta lejos del grupo; el resto interrumpe hechizos y sale de Dark Mist.
payload.summary_es: El tanque la orienta lejos del grupo; el resto interrumpe hechizos y sale de Dark Mist.
encounter_notes: Manor Claviger has an untelegraphed melee cleaver attack. The attack can do massive physical damage to lightly armored party members. Make sure the tank faces her away from the rest of the party. When defeated, the doors leading to the Foyer will open, and Claviger will drop a Green Key. Do not go forward to the Foyer. Instead, proceed back out of the entrance of the boss room and use the Green Key to unlock the Ivy Door.
*Sweet Steel is an untelegraphed cone AoE melee attack.
*Void Fire II is an interruptible AoE spell, typically targeted on a player at range from the boss (ranged DPS, healer).
*Dark Mist is a large PBAoE spell. This spell can be avoided by stunning Claviger.

payload.name: Hellbender
payload.summary: Sal de Peculiar Light y rompe inmediatamente la burbuja que encierra a un compañero.
payload.summary_es: Sal de Peculiar Light y rompe inmediatamente la burbuja que encierra a un compañero.
encounter_notes: * Bog Bubble: an uncasted circular AoE around a random party member, dealing moderate damage.
* Stagnant Spray: a casted conal AoE toward the main target.
* Peculiar Light: an AoE centred around the boss. Will inflict a cleanseable magic vulnerability up Magic Vulnerability Up.

* Effluvium: the boss will target a random party member and encase them in a Queer Bubble add, inflicting bind Bind, Physical Damage Down (decreases the player's physical damage), Mana Modulation (decreases the player's damage dealt with spells and reduces HP restored via healing magic), and dropsy Dropsy.
** Kill the Queer Bubble to free and cleanse the afflicted party member's debuffs.
* Very susceptible to from Beastmaster's Treant.
* At around 15% HP, Aiatar will descend onto the arena, killing Hellbender. Aiatar will resume the boss fight.
** Touchdown: very light damage and a knockback from where Aiatar first descends.
** Salivous Snap: a magical tankbuster that inflicts a cleansable poison Poison detriment.
** Dragon Breath: a line AoE targeting a random party member. Inflicts poison Poison if hit.
* At 70% HP, Aiatar will fly away, ending the boss fight.

payload.name: Lady Amandine
payload.summary: Resuelve el ojo mirando en dirección contraria, mata a la handmaiden y corta los hechizos peligrosos.
payload.summary_es: Resuelve el ojo mirando en dirección contraria, mata a la handmaiden y corta los hechizos peligrosos.
encounter_notes: Lady Amandine, a former Elezen thaumaturge, is the main boss of Haukke Manor.

As of patch 6.1, the boss mechanics have changed. She will first summon a Manor Sentry, who will introduce the gaze attack marker (large purple eye) to players. Players can avoid this attack by turning their character to look away from the add. They can also stand between the boss and the add to keep attacking safely. Afterwards, she will summon a targetable Lady's Handmaiden add, which should be killed because it will cast Stoneskin on the boss.

Afterwards, Lady Amandine summon another Manor Sentry add and will teleport to one side of the arena and cast a Seduce debuff, causing you to walk slowly towards her while the Sentry casts its gaze attack. Once the seduce wears off, players can look away from the add to avoid the gaze.
Lady Amandine will also cast Void Fire and Void Thunder. Avoid her spellcast if possible by interrupting her.
*Void Fire III is an interruptible spell.
*Void Thunder III is an interruptible tankbuster.
*Dark Mist is a large PBAoE spell. This spell can be avoided by stunning Lady Amandine.

payload.name: Great Yellow Pelican
payload.summary: Controla la oleada de Violet Backs y evita la respiración frontal que paraliza.
payload.summary_es: Controla la oleada de Violet Backs y evita la respiración frontal que paraliza.
encounter_notes: * The boss will periodically summon several Violet Back adds throughout and at the beginning of the fight. These adds can inflict a cleansable poison Poison detrimental effect.
* Numbing Breath: a conal AoE from the boss that afflicts a cleansable paralysis Paralysis detrimental effect.
* Hammer Beak: an uncasted moderately-damaging attack.
* Susceptible to from Beastmaster's Ghost.

payload.name: Inferno Drake
payload.summary: Cuando aparece el Tempest Biast, el tanque lo recoge; evita el cleave que sigue a la provocación de Brayflox.
payload.summary_es: Cuando aparece el Tempest Biast, el tanque lo recoge; evita el cleave que sigue a la provocación de Brayflox.
encounter_notes: * At 75% health, a Tempest Biast add will spawn. This add should be taken by the tank.
** Levinfang/Levinshower: an uncasted conal AoE that does light damage.
* Brayflox will periodically establish top aggression over the boss using Bang Toss.
** Blaze Spikes: is granted. Players attacking enemies with melee attacks will receive very light damage.

** Burning Cyclone: Brayflox will then go to a random party member for the boss to use Burning Cyclone on, which does light-moderate damage in a cleave to the player. This can be stunned stun Stunned to cancel the attack.
* Susceptible to from Beastmaster's Worm.

payload.name: Queen Hawk
payload.summary: There are several bees that randomly fly around the edge of the room. They will target random players and use a column AoE attack that needs to be dodged. When the Queen uses 'Ally', they will gather in two groups along the edge and launch a huge double column AoE attack with no ground marker. The bees blend in with the walls so you will need to pay attention to get out of the way in time. Partway through the fight, several Knight Hawk bee adds will appear and tether to the boss. This is a DPS check where the boss will do raid wide damage that gets stronger every time, so burn them down quickly. *Do not stand in front of bees
encounter_notes: There are several bees that randomly fly around the edge of the room. They will target random players and use a column AoE attack that needs to be dodged. When the Queen uses 'Ally', they will gather in two groups along the edge and launch a huge double column AoE attack with no ground marker. The bees blend in with the walls so you will need to pay attention to get out of the way in time.

Partway through the fight, several Knight Hawk bee adds will appear and tether to the boss. This is a DPS check where the boss will do raid wide damage that gets stronger every time, so burn them down quickly.
*Do not stand in front of bees
*Kill Knight Hawk adds
*Uses Blue Mage spell Avail

payload.name: Aiatar
payload.summary: Lee las dos tandas de pods venenosos: esquiva la primera y entra en su espacio cuando explote.
payload.summary_es: Lee las dos tandas de pods venenosos: esquiva la primera y entra en su espacio cuando explote.
encounter_notes: * Salivous Snap: a magical tankbuster that inflicts a cleansable poison Poison detriment.
* Toxic Vomit: four small circular AoEs that appear around the arena. Will spawn poisonous pods that will grow in size and eventually explode in wider AoEs. Inflicts poison Poison.
** After the first cast of Toxic Vomit, a second set of poisonous pods will follow the first set, and explode after first set. Dodge into where the first poisonous pods were after they explode.
* Dragon Breath: a line AoE targeting a random party member. Inflicts poison Poison if hit.
*Healers can use Esuna to cure poison from any party member.

payload.name: Teratotaur
payload.summary: Dos prioridades absolutas: matar Dung Wespes antes de Final Sting y limpiar Doom pisando la placa naranja.
payload.summary_es: Dos prioridades absolutas: matar Dung Wespes antes de Final Sting y limpiar Doom pisando la placa naranja.
encounter_notes: Teratotaur is the first boss of The Sunken Temple of Qarn. The boss fight has multiple instant death mechanics, involving adds and three square plates positioned around the arena.
*Triclip: Telegraphed tankbuster.
* Two Dung Wespe adds will spawn. Kill these quickly or they will use Final Sting on their target and deal massive damage (70% of their maximum HP; two hits will be instant death).
*Frightful Roar: Telegraphed point-blank AoE. Anyone hit will receive a 15-second Physical Vulnerability Up which can be cleansed with Esuna.
*Mow: Telegraphed frontal conal AoE. Anyone hit will receive a 15-second Poison which can be cleansed with Esuna.
*Mortal Ray: A room-wide AoE that will inflict everyone with a Doom debuff on your entire party; the debuff lasts 12 seconds and will instantly kill anyone still afflicted by it when the timer ends.
**The boss can be stunned (using actions such as Low Blow or Leg Sweep during the cast to prevent it.

**Players can remove this debuff by stepping on the square plate that is glowing orange; only one of them will turn orange at a time.
